constraints: Has no effect if there is no current record for aTable in the process (including if the record was unloaded before the call, e.g. via UNLOAD RECORD).
Does nothing when the table is in READ ONLY mode, regardless of whether the record to be deleted is locked.
Permanent and cannot be undone outside of a transaction (see Using Transactions).
Deleted record numbers are reused by subsequently created records -- do not use the record number as a durable record identifier if records may ever be deleted.
